Minimize sample-summed S1 over every feasible root, retaining MW on ties and requiring strict S1 improvement. Keep exact FIFO scoring, complete loaded-job offsets/reservations, ordinary MW continuation and the original queue envelope.

execution.sources: Freeze literal original dependencies, new S1-only policy and runner plus reused paired-metric helpers at registration. Original development caches remain unchanged; full new trajectories stay on server.

outcomes.primary_comparison: S1-only minus cached no-background S1/S2; negative means removing the S2 constraint improves the metric
secondary: Number of selected roots with predicted S2 greater than MW and actual work
outcomes.common_population: Recompute completed-ID intersection separately for S1/no-background, S1/BG and S1/MW at each cutoff. Do not transfer P90s between comparisons.
outcomes.MW_reference_screen: Retain original 1% mean improvement, load nonregression, 5% per-group P90/unfinished tolerance and pooled tail nonincrease against cached MW. This is a development screen, not automatic adoption or a new confirmation.

statistics: Three reused actual-arrival seeds with eight paired cells per seed, conditional on fixed planning streams. Give all block and group point estimates; do not treat24 cells as independent, bootstrap three blocks into a confirmation claim or use the hard-coded twelve-block CI module.
interpretation: This is a mean-only one-step stochastic MW-rollout comparator under the same information, population and sample budget. S1 can improve while actual P90 or unfinished tails worsen: retain both. A weaker result after removing S2 supports its role in this model; domination by S1-only requires narrowing the risk-constraint contribution. Do not tune coefficients, alter the original BG main result, revive finite/current-policy continuation or edit the paper.
